description: A SessionStart(compact) hook that nudges a compacted lead to run lead-revive before anything else, and the Claude mod (claude-mod/register.ts), the one hooks module Claude Code accepts per plugin. Its mailbox push feature: once the agent binds its session key through the mod's mailbox watch tool, arriving cross-session mail starts a turn even in an idle session. Its lead compaction timing feature (ws only): advisory and milestone wake turns before native auto compaction, and a compaction request tool the lead calls at a boundary of its choosing. Its MCP reconnect feature: a reconnect request tool the agent calls when the plugin's MCP server has gone, and a /mcp reconnect at the next main-thread turn end followed by the agent's continuation. Its workflow manual injection feature (ws only, in a project with ai-docs/WORKFLOW.md at its repository root): a lead session key minted per conversation and the keyed workflow manual carried in the system prompt, workflow_manual answered with the session state alone while the prompt carries the manual, and a repeated playbook_read or workflow_manual collapsed to a pointer while its earlier result is still in the conversation. Claude Code auto-discovers this file by its hooks/hooks.json path; there is no plugin.json pointer to it (contrast the Codex adapter, whose manifest names its hooks file explicitly).
